partition_basis: F5_PLAN §3 decision 3: of the 22 E1 text features the 13 red-flag columns are exploratory (demoted 2026-08-27), leaving 9; share_chunks_8k_body is dropped (identically zero under decision 9), so the confirmatory text block is these 8 legacy features. The two zero-labeling families (YoY novelty, pooled embeddings) are NOT built here and are not part of this artifact.

caveats.teacher_red_flag_error: v1.2 TEACHER red-flag exact-set error 84/200 = 42.00% [35.37, 48.93] (data/hardening/spotcheck_v12/results_v12.json). The owner-ratified DEMOTE pre-commitment fired (2026-08-27): E2 red flags are EXPLORATORY / disclosure-only in G3. These student labels reproduce a teacher measured at that error rate.
caveats.student_sentiment: G2 student spot-check: sentiment agreement 293/337 = 86.9% [82.9, 90.1]; verdict INDETERMINATE at the owner-ratified 0.85 bar.
caveats.student_guidance: G2 student spot-check: guidance_direction agreement 115/119 = 96.6% [91.7, 98.7]; verdict PASS at the 0.85 bar. MANDATORY escorts (G2 §0 / §6.3): the PASS is a statement about the NONE mass -- active-value precision is 68.67% [58.17, 77.55] (n=100, n_eff=84.77), and the false-NONE rate is 0/80 = 0.0% [0.0, 4.58].
caveats.provenance: model-consensus agreement (blind rater + adjudicator, both Claude-family) with owner rulings superseding on the escalated subset; NOT human validation of ground truth (HANDOFF §3).
caveats.e1_constants_not_applicable: E1's red-flag agreement constants describe E1's Claude teacher on E1's corpus and are NEVER carried onto these Qwen student labels (current-era rule); the two measurements above replace them.

teacher_v12_exact_set_error.rule: demote iff Wilson lower bound STRICTLY > 0.35 (boundary equality does NOT demote)

guidance_signed_mean.definition: Mean of GUIDANCE_MAP(guidance_direction) over guidance-applicable attributed chunks (RAISED +1 / MAINTAINED 0 / LOWERED -1 / WITHDRAWN -1); NONE and null are excluded, not zero-filled.
guidance_signed_mean.caveat: Section mask applied before aggregation (G2 §3.4): 4177 RISK_FACTORS sentiment values and 2826 MDA/RISK_FACTORS guidance values (230 of them active) are nulled, not scored. 48293 frame rows carry guidance_imputed_none = true (51.08% of the 94545 guidance-applicable frame rows; 48790 = 51.18% corpus-wide). They count as NONE by the F4 writer rule, i.e. GUIDANCE_MAP gives them no score: they neither enter guidance_signed_mean nor set guidance_any_present. WITHDRAWN is kept at -1 per E1's GUIDANCE_MAP; F5_PLAN §3 decision 11 (n = 66 on E2) is an owner ruling at G3. G2 student spot-check: guidance_direction agreement 115/119 = 96.6% [91.7, 98.7]; verdict PASS at the 0.85 bar. MANDATORY escorts (G2 §0 / §6.3): the PASS is a statement about the NONE mass -- active-value precision is 68.67% [58.17, 77.55] (n=100, n_eff=84.77), and the false-NONE rate is 0/80 = 0.0% [0.0, 4.58]. model-consensus agreement (blind rater + adjudicator, both Claude-family) with owner rulings superseding on the escalated subset; NOT human validation of ground truth (HANDOFF §3).

train_overlap_share.definition: Share of this filing's attributed chunks flagged train_overlap. overlap(row) = row.home_accession_number in train_acc or any(a in train_acc for a in row.source_accession_numbers) or sha1(normalize(row.text)) in train_txt, where train_acc / train_txt come from finetune/splits_v12/train.parquet and normalize = collapse whitespace, strip, lower (G2 §2.5 / build_draw_g2.py). Paragraph-id joins are FORBIDDEN: E1 ids are 'P-...' and E2's are 'E2P-...', so an id-join returns a structurally meaningless 0.
train_overlap_share.caveat: Key results are reported with and without the overlap set (EXPANSION_PLAN §3 item 2). Accession-level overlap is a LOWER BOUND on memorization exposure: home-CIK exposure is 15.85% (G2 §2.5).

selfid_share.definition: Share of this filing's attributed chunks where the company self-identifies in the passage text. selfid(row) is true iff the first token of the row's home company name that is longer than 2 characters (after stripping surrounding punctuation) and not in the generic-suffix stop list, lowercased, occurs in lower(text).
selfid_share.caveat: Disclosure of how often the labeler could see whose filing it was reading.

cross_cik_share.definition: Share of this filing's attributed chunks whose HOME filing belongs to a different CIK.
cross_cik_share.caveat: Measures the union-over-paragraphs attribution property described in the module docstring. Disposition is an open G3 question, not a default.
